text_en: Alas for those who devise wickedness and evil deeds on their beds! When the morning dawns, they perform it, because it is in their power.
text_cn: 祸哉，那些在床上筹划不义，图谋行恶的人！因为他们手中有能力，一到天亮，就去实行。

text_en: They covet fields, and seize them; houses, and take them away; they oppress householder and house, people and their inheritance.
text_cn: 他们想要田地，便去霸占；想要房屋，便去夺取：以暴力对付业主和他的家族，物主和他的产业。

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord : Now, I am devising against this family an evil from which you cannot remove your necks; and you shall not walk haughtily, for it will be an evil time.
text_cn: 为此上主这样说：“看，我正在为这一家筹划灾祸，致令你们不能缩回你们的颈项，也不能挺身前行，因为那是一个灾祸的时刻。”

text_en: On that day they shall take up a taunt song against you, and wail with bitter lamentation, and say, “We are utterly ruined; the Lord alters the inheritance of my people; how he removes it from me! Among our captors he parcels out our fields. ”
text_cn: 在那一日，人要作诗讽刺你们，唱这悲惨的哀歌说：“我们完全被抢掠了，我人民的基业已被人瓜分了，再无人归还；我们的土地已分配给抢掠我们的人！”

text_en: Therefore you will have no one to cast the line by lot in the assembly of the Lord .
text_cn: 因此，你们在上主的集会中，再没有拉绳测量和抽签的人。

text_en: “Do not preach”—thus they preach— “one should not preach of such things; disgrace will not overtake us. ”
text_cn: 他们讲说：“你们不要说预言。”“人不该预言这样的事，耻辱决不会来到我们身上！

text_en: Should this be said, O house of Jacob? Is the Lord ’s patience exhausted? Are these his doings? Do not my words do good to one who walks uprightly?
text_cn: 雅各伯的家岂是可诅咒的？上主的气量岂能变为狭小？难道这是他的作风？他的话岂不是有益于以色列子民？”

text_en: But you rise up against my people as an enemy; you strip the robe from the peaceful, from those who pass by trustingly with no thought of war.
text_cn: “但是你们正像敌人一样，起来攻击我的人民，因为你们向没有短衣的人索求长袍，向平安走路的人索取战利品。

text_en: The women of my people you drive out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my glory forever.
text_cn: 你们驱逐我人民的妇女离开她们的快乐家庭，从她们的婴儿身上，永远夺去我的光荣。

text_en: Arise and go; for this is no place to rest, because of uncleanness that destroys with a grievous destruction.
text_cn: 你们起来走罢！因为这不是你们安息之所。为了不洁，这地必要遭受不可挽救的毁灭。”

text_en: If someone were to go about uttering empty falsehoods, saying, “I will preach to you of wine and strong drink, ” such a one would be the preacher for this people!
text_cn: 假若有人随从虚妄而撒谎说：“我要对你预言清酒和醇酒。”这人必可作这民族的先知。

text_en: I will surely gather all of you, O Jacob, I will gather the survivors of Israel; I will set them together like sheep in a fold, like a flock in its pasture; it will resound with people.
text_cn: 我必要聚集雅各伯全民众，我必要集合以色列的遗民，使他们合并在一处，有如羊栏里的绵羊，有如牧场上的羊群，不再怕任何人。

text_en: The one who breaks out will go up before them; they will break through and pass the gate, going out by it. Their king will pass on before them, the Lord at their head.
text_cn: 开路者走在他们前面开道；他走在前面，众人随他穿门而过；他们的君王走在他们前面，上主亲作他们的向导。
